# US Grid Demand Dashboard

> Live and recent US electricity demand across 15 balancing authorities (~95% of CONUS), from EIA Open Data via kardashev-data.

Part of [Kardashev Labs](https://kardashevlabs.org).

## Terms

- **Demand / load**: MW consumed on a BA system in a given hour
- **Balancing authority**: entity matching supply and demand in real time (CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, …)
- **Forecast demand**: day-ahead or short-term load forecast shown next to actuals when available

## Coverage

15 BAs including CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE, and others. Hourly EIA cadence.
